title: Tencent Q3 Report: WorkBuddy Ranks First in China for Average Daily Token Usage, Cloud Revenue Up 35% YoY

content_html:
On November 18, Tencent Holdings (00700.HK) released its financial results for the third quarter of 2026. Its AI business achieved several breakthroughs: the latest-generation Hunyuan large model, Hy4, ranked first among Chinese models on Agent Arena at launch; WorkBuddy's daily active users exceeded 10 million, with average daily token consumption exceeding 100 trillion, making it the AI product with the highest average daily large language model token consumption in China; the grey-testing scope of WeChat AI assistant "Xiaowei" continued to expand; and AI demand drove cloud service revenue up 35% year-on-year.

In the third quarter, Tencent's revenue was RMB 207.34 billion, up 8% year-on-year; revenue from its three business segments—marketing services, value-added services, and fintech and business services—grew 19%, 3%, and 9% year-on-year, respectively; excluding the contribution of new AI products, operating profit rose 8% year-on-year to RMB 83.3 billion. The company has ample cash reserves, and the value of its investment portfolio reached several hundred billion yuan; excluding prepayments for computing power procurement, free cash flow was RMB 16.9 billion. In the same period, Tencent's capital expenditure payments were RMB 65.1 billion and its R&D investment was RMB 32.36 billion, up 226% and 42% year-on-year, respectively.

Ma Huateng, Chairman of the Board and Chief Executive Officer of Tencent, said, "We have made a series of important advances at the model and application levels, accelerating Tencent's evolution toward a new AI era."
